evals.prompt: explain my changes compared to develop
evals.expected_output: <branch-slug>-changes.md with comparison line, traced before/after behaviour and PR text.
expectations: Every behaviour claim carries a path:start-end reference that holds the code it describes
Every intent claim is labelled confirmed, likely or unknown, and none is marked confirmed without a commit message, doc or test saying so
States that upload() now returns None after the last failed attempt, where app/cli.py indexes the result
Describes RETRIES = 3 as three attempts, not three retries
Contains no review findings or refactoring advice

evals.expected_output: On the base branch: ask which branch to explain, write nothing.
expectations: Asks which branch to explain before explaining any change

evals.prompt: explain my branch for the PR (I'm running in a PowerShell terminal)
evals.expected_output: PowerShell-safe: one plain git command per call, and the report still written.
expectations: Uses no grep, sed, awk, cat -n, pipes, $(...), or && / ; chaining (the harness's cd prefix excepted)
Never commits, pushes, fetches or checks out
